target.command:
cd /home/john/mynotes/deterministic_equidistribution_theory/c_suite
make 2>&1 | grep -iE "error|warning" | head; echo built
echo "=== E with Arnoldi, Q=9,27,81 (was: Q=9 k=3 gap_ratio=1.054, residual 9%) ==="
time ./collatz_tests spectral-gaps --moduli 9,27,81 --tilts 0,1 --L 48 --R 6 --bmax 20 --char-cap 4 --output-dir /tmp/etest 2>/dev/null
echo "Q,k,s,rho,rho0,gap_ratio,iters(m),residual,gap_units"
grep -v '^#' /tmp/etest/spectral_gaps.csv | grep -v '^Q,L' | awk -F, '$6!="trivial"{printf "Q=%-3s k=%s s=%-6s rho=%.5f rho0=%.5f gap=%.4f m=%s res=%s gap_u=%.4f\n",$1,$7,$5,$8,$9,$10,$11,$12,$17}'
echo "--- any gap_ratio_units > 1 (Wielandt violation)? ---"
grep -v '^#' /tmp/etest/spectral_gaps.csv | grep -v '^Q,L' | awk -F, '$6!="trivial" && $17>1.0001{print "VIOLATION:",$1,$7,$5,$17}'; echo "(none above = fixed)"
